content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Tehsil Office Bhatkuli Revenue Servant (Kotwal)
content_sections.text: Obtain the prescribed application form from the Tehsil Office, Bhatkuli between 02-10-2026 and 17-10-2026 (11:00 AM to 04:15 PM, excluding holidays) by paying the required fee of Rs. 10/- for the form. Fill out the application form manually in the prescribed format with accurate details. content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: 4th standard passing marksheet or highest educational merit marksheet/certificate. School leaving certificate or birth certificate showing date of birth, or 10th standard certificate. Residential proof of the sajha (House tax receipt, Ration card, Voter ID, or Aadhaar card). Domicile certificate issued by Police Patil, Talathi, or Gramsevak. Self-attested copy of photo identity proof (Aadhaar Card, Voter ID card, or PAN Card). Caste certificate and Caste Validity Certificate (if applicable), along with Non-Creamy Layer Certificate for backward class candidates. EWS certificate for economically weaker section candidates (if applicable). Small family certificate in the prescribed format.
